label: Bible Study
prompt: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore _____ yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verse: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
note: Peter quotes the heart of this verse in his first letter: 'Be ye holy; for I am holy.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of _____ harvest.
verse: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.
note: Naomi came home empty — right at barley harvest, the very season Ruth would meet Boaz.

label: Sunday School
prompt: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the _____ were wrapped about my head.
verse: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.
note: From inside the fish Jonah prays about weeds wrapped around his head — the Bible's soggiest prayer.

label: Deep Water
prompt: A little leaven leaveneth the whole _____.
verse: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
note: Paul's kitchen proverb about false teaching — he uses the very same line in 1 Corinthians 5:6.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the _____ thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.
verse: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.
note: The mountain before Zerubbabel becomes a plain, and the 'headstone' comes out with shouts of 'Grace, grace unto it.'
